lines: Thanks for having me. Before RMI Agentic I spent about seven years at Credit Suisse and left as a Vice President.
Mitesh and I go back a long way, we worked together at Nomura. That's where we first met.
Before Credit Suisse I was a Managing Director at Nomura, running the whole data platform.
We started RMI Agentic this May, and the team is around 25 people today.
